$description: Hand-written. Motion timing, the same in every mode. v1's one transition (--transition-base: 0.4s ease), split into a duration and an easing, with the shorthand kept (Kyle, 2026-10-27). The color moves' own timings (button hover, line pulses, icons) live with their components.

base.$description: State changes: hover, focus, a theme switch, a surface moving.
Duration and easing together, for a CSS transition: `transition: color var(--transition-base)`.
